scope: Migration and shared component foundations; not full competitor feature parity

sources.observation: Scalar data tags use d-prefixed dotted paths; arrays and parent lookups have additional semantics.
Carbone offers upperCase and lowerCase text formatters.

sources.evidenceType: downloaded public source package and executed runtime oracle
sources.observation: Twelve renderXML cases captured in tests/fixtures/migration/carbone-oracle.json. Case formatters preserve numeric and boolean inputs, while Imprint requires strings. A general formatter mapping would silently change supported behavior.
sources.reproduction: Install carbone@3.8.2 into an isolated temporary prefix with --ignore-scripts, then invoke tests/fixtures/migration/carbone-probe.cjs with the absolute installed module path. No competitor source redistributed or added to production dependencies.

sources.observation: Report Definition is described as a text description of report design. This does not establish a stable native interchange grammar or equivalent executable formula semantics.

implemented.design: Preserve scalar placeholders; optionally map upperCase/lowerCase chains to upper()/lower() only with an explicit stringFields contract and en-US locale. Report unsupported tokens by exact source offset. An unsupported token cancels all proposed edits. Return original source, required contracts and required follow-up checks.
implemented.limits: compileCarboneText enforces string contracts and pins en-US on every TXT render; callers using the migration report directly must enforce the reported contracts themselves. Lexical compatibility does not establish package structure or layout equivalence. No Office package editing, repeat translation, numeric/date formatter migration or arbitrary expression execution.

implemented.design: Validate imprint-crystal-inventory-v1 metadata and enumerate field, formula, group and subreport migration tasks.
implemented.limits: No proprietary RPT decoding, native SAP export parsing, automatic formulas or layout conversion; no licensed Crystal runtime or authentic RPT oracle was available.

implemented.design: Immutable registry of exact component versions; nested expansion with content hashes, transitive template impact, missing/cycle checks and bounded graph/output expansion.
implemented.limits: Plain text only. No rich Office fragment merging, persisted authoring UI or automatic rollout. Impact enumerates caller-supplied templates, not an undisclosed template database.

confidence: Bounded evidence, not a claim of exhaustive coverage or 100 percent correctness. Release of full migration and rich document components remains blocked by the listed gaps.
